items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You’re talking about hearing Jimmie Lunceford? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, and Earl Hines.

ctx.x: Oh, listen. And I said, oh, looky here. We were getting live music every week for a period of time.
